name: Sigil
summary: A neon sacred-geometry glyph: rings per band, rays on onsets, orbs by pitch, rebuilt on every track.
hint: Rings breathe with their band (sub to air, inside out), rays strike on onsets at the angle of the pitch class, the orbs light with the chord, the star and triangles turn with energy and step on bars, a pen writes the sigil trace in time with the beat, and paint runs from whatever is bright when it is loud. Every track draws a new glyph. Give the layer the neon or rave palette.

params.label: Afterimage
params.help: How long rays, the pen and drips linger.

params.label: Core
params.help: The innermost ring and the flare on drops.

params.label: Shapes
params.help: The centre star, the cardinal triangles and the diamonds.

params.label: Trace
params.help: The sigil trace and its pen.

params.label: Ground
params.help: A painterly ground with splatter (0: the glyph stands alone).

params.label: Rebuild on section change
params.help: Put the glyph out and light one for each section of the song; a section that comes back (a chorus) relights its glyph. Sections are found as the song plays and are approximate.

params.label: New arrangement
params.help: Put the glyph out and light a new one.
